name: Your.Rentals API
description: The Your.Rentals API provides access to high quality holiday rentals inventory for Holiday Rentals websites, Sales Channels and Channel Managers. It exposes listings, availability, rates, bookings, quotes and reference dictionaries. To request access, contact api@your.rentals. All prices are returned in EUR.
